characters.name: The Simulator
characters.title: The Visionary
characters.bio: He has watched more football, hockey and hoops than anyone alive, and it shows: by the time the anthem ends he has already seen every way the night can go. Quiet, unflappable, allergic to hype. When a favorite is supposed to roll, he is the one who knows whether it actually will.
characters.origin: Grew up in a film room with the lights off. Learned early that the game tells you what it is going to do if you have watched it enough times.

characters.name: The Judge
characters.title: The Gavel
characters.bio: Nobody talks over the Judge. She lets every voice in the room make its case, then rules, and her rulings stick. Patient, fair and impossible to rush, she is at her best when the desk is split and somebody has to decide.
characters.origin: Spent years listening to experts argue and keeping score of who was actually right. Trusts a track record over a loud voice, every time.

characters.name: The Scorekeeper
characters.title: The Scorekeeper
characters.bio: Give her a game and she will hand you the final before kickoff. She does not care about stories or streaks, only how points actually get scored, possession by possession. Deadly on totals and on games where everyone else is guessing.
characters.origin: Kept the official book in a press box for years. Watched every point go up on the board and learned exactly where they come from.

characters.name: The Banker
characters.title: The Money Man
characters.bio: The Banker keeps the books for the whole desk and only backs where the strongest accounts are. Calm, disciplined, never chasing. His parlays are built the way he runs money: carefully, and only with the pieces that have earned it.
characters.origin: Ran the money before he ever made a pick. Learned that discipline beats brilliance over a long season.
